with mf as (
  select f.trade_id, t.market_ticker, t.ts_ms, t.taker_outcome_side
    from execution_fill_events f
    join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id = f.kalshi_order_id
    join execution_trade_events t on t.trade_id = f.trade_id
   where o.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and o.action = 'buy' and o.side = 'no'
), agg as (
  select mf.trade_id, sum(t2.count_fp) as taker_size, count(*) as matches
    from mf join execution_trade_events t2
      on t2.market_ticker = mf.market_ticker and t2.ts_ms = mf.ts_ms
     and coalesce(t2.taker_outcome_side,'') = coalesce(mf.taker_outcome_side,'')
   group by mf.trade_id
)
select count(*) fills,
       count(*) filter (where taker_size >= 3) ge3, count(*) filter (where taker_size >= 10) ge10,
       count(*) filter (where taker_size < 3) lt3,
       percentile_disc(0.25) within group (order by taker_size) p25,
       percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by taker_size) p50,
       percentile_disc(0.75) within group (order by taker_size) p75,
       percentile_disc(0.9) within group (order by taker_size) p90,
       avg(matches)::numeric(8,2) avg_matches
  from agg
